```{r}

library(GenomicRanges)
library(rtracklayer)
library(ComplexHeatmap) # Recommended for UpSet plots; alternative: library(UpSetR)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)


peak_dir <- "/data/jenuwein/erikson/2026/ulATAC/project_3910/hg38_AOS/peaks"
setwd(peak_dir)


peak_files <- list.files(pattern = "\\.filtered_peaks\\.narrowPeak$", full.names = TRUE)

# Read peak files into a list of GRanges objects
peak_list <- lapply(peak_files, function(f) {
  import(f, format = "narrowPeak")
})

# Name the list elements using file basenames without extensions
names(peak_list) <- gsub("\\.filtered_peaks\\.narrowPeak$", "", basename(peak_files))


# Define condition groups by removing "_rep1" or "_rep2" suffixes
groups <- gsub("_rep[12]$", "", names(peak_list))
unique_groups <- unique(groups)

merged_peak_list <- lapply(unique_groups, function(grp) {
  # Get indices for replicates belonging to this group
  rep_indices <- which(groups == grp)
  reps <- peak_list[rep_indices]
  
  if (length(reps) == 1) {
    return(reps[[1]])
  } else {
    # Union of both replicates: merge peak regions that overlap in either replicate
    # (Alternatively, use 'intersect' or findOverlaps to require peak presence in BOTH)
    return(reduce(c(reps[[1]], reps[[2]])))
  }
})
names(merged_peak_list) <- unique_groups

# Build dynamic presence/absence binary matrix for merged conditions
mat_merged <- make_upset_matrix(merged_peak_list)

# Plot UpSet diagram for merged conditions
pdf("/data/jenuwein/erikson/Bhabesh/20260810_Project3910_UpSet_merged_conditions.pdf", width = 10, height = 5)
m_merged <- make_comb_mat(mat_merged)
print(
  UpSet(
    m_merged,
    comb_order = order(comb_size(m_merged), decreasing = TRUE),
    top_annotation = upset_top_annotation(m_merged, add_numbers = TRUE),
    right_annotation = upset_right_annotation(m_merged, add_numbers = TRUE)
  )
)
dev.off()
```
```{r}
# 1. Load required libraries
library(GenomicRanges)
library(rtracklayer)
library(ComplexHeatmap) # Recommended for UpSet plots; alternative: library(UpSetR)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

# Set working directory to your peaks path
peak_dir <- "/data/jenuwein/erikson/2026/ulATAC/project_3910/hg38_AOS/peaks"
setwd(peak_dir)

# 2. Get all narrowPeak files
peak_files <- list.files(pattern = "\\.filtered_peaks\\.narrowPeak$", full.names = TRUE)

# Read peak files into a list of GRanges objects
peak_list <- lapply(peak_files, function(f) {
  import(f, format = "narrowPeak")
})

# Name the list elements using file basenames without extensions
names(peak_list) <- gsub("\\.filtered_peaks\\.narrowPeak$", "", basename(peak_files))

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# OPTION A: Plot all individual replicates directly
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

make_upset_matrix <- function(gr_list) {
  # Master set of all union genomic regions
  all_peaks_union <- reduce(unlist(GRangesList(gr_list)))
  
  # Build a 0/1 binary presence matrix
  mat <- sapply(gr_list, function(gr) {
    as.integer(overlapsAny(all_peaks_union, gr))
  })
  
  return(mat)
}

mat_reps <- make_upset_matrix(peak_list)

# Plot UpSet diagram for all individual samples
pdf("UpSet_all_replicates.pdf", width = 12, height = 6)
m_reps <- make_comb_mat(mat_reps)
print(UpSet(m_reps, comb_order = order(comb_size(m_reps), decreasing = TRUE)))
dev.off()


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# OPTION B: Merge biological replicates per conditions
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Define condition groups by removing "_rep1" or "_rep2" suffixes
groups <- gsub("_rep[12]$", "", names(peak_list))
unique_groups <- unique(groups)

merged_peak_list <- lapply(unique_groups, function(grp) {
  # Get indices for replicates belonging to this group
  rep_indices <- which(groups == grp)
  reps <- peak_list[rep_indices]
  
  if (length(reps) == 1) {
    return(reps[[1]])
  } else {
    # Union of both replicates: merge peak regions that overlap in either replicate
    # (Alternatively, use 'intersect' or findOverlaps to require peak presence in BOTH)
    return(reduce(c(reps[[1]], reps[[2]])))
  }
})
names(merged_peak_list) <- unique_groups

# Build dynamic presence/absence binary matrix for merged conditions
mat_merged <- make_upset_matrix(merged_peak_list)

# Plot UpSet diagram for merged conditions
pdf("UpSet_merged_conditions.pdf", width = 10, height = 5)
m_merged <- make_comb_mat(mat_merged)
print(
  UpSet(
    m_merged,
    comb_order = order(comb_size(m_merged), decreasing = TRUE),
    top_annotation = upset_top_annotation(m_merged, add_numbers = TRUE),
    right_annotation = upset_right_annotation(m_merged, add_numbers = TRUE)
  )
)
dev.off()

```

```{r}
library(GenomicRanges)
library(rtracklayer)
library(UpSetR)

# Set working directory
setwd("/data/jenuwein/erikson/2026/ulATAC/project_3910/hg38_AOS/peaks")

# 1. Read peak files
peak_files <- list.files(pattern = "\\.filtered_peaks\\.narrowPeak$", full.names = TRUE)
peak_list <- lapply(peak_files, function(f) import(f, format = "narrowPeak"))
names(peak_list) <- gsub("\\.filtered_peaks\\.narrowPeak$", "", basename(peak_files))

# 2. Merge replicates (Union)
groups <- gsub("_rep[12]$", "", names(peak_list))
unique_groups <- unique(groups)

merged_peak_list <- lapply(unique_groups, function(grp) {
  reps <- peak_list[groups == grp]
  reduce(unlist(GRangesList(reps)))
})
names(merged_peak_list) <- unique_groups

# 3. Create master union and binary matrix
master_union <- reduce(unlist(GRangesList(merged_peak_list)))
presence_df <- as.data.frame(lapply(merged_peak_list, function(gr) {
  as.integer(overlapsAny(master_union, gr))
}))

# 4. Map original sample names to ordered short names
# Original names: HepG2_omniATAC_LowCell_10, HepG2_omniATAC_HighCell_10000, etc.
name_mapping <- c(
  "HepG2_omniATAC_LowCell_10"     = "omniATAC_10",
  "HepG2_omniATAC_LowCell_100"    = "omniATAC_100",
  "HepG2_omniATAC_LowCell_1000"   = "omniATAC_1000",
  "HepG2_omniATAC_LowCell_5000"   = "omniATAC_5000",
  "HepG2_omniATAC_HighCell_5000"  = "omniATAC_5000_High",  # Note: You had both LowCell_5000 and HighCell_5000
  "HepG2_omniATAC_HighCell_10000" = "omniATAC_10000",
  "HepG2_omniATAC_HighCell_25000" = "omniATAC_25000",
  "HepG2_omniATAC_HighCell_50000" = "omniATAC_50000"
)

# Apply renaming to dataframe columns
colnames(presence_df) <- ifelse(
  colnames(presence_df) %in% names(name_mapping),
  name_mapping[colnames(presence_df)],
  colnames(presence_df)
)

# 5. Define exact desired display order
target_order <- c(
  "omniATAC_10",
  "omniATAC_100",
  "omniATAC_1000",
  "omniATAC_5000",
  "omniATAC_5000_High",
  "omniATAC_10000",
  "omniATAC_25000",
  "omniATAC_50000"
)

# Filter order vector to only sets actually present in dataframe
sets_to_plot <- target_order[target_order %in% colnames(presence_df)]

# 6. Plot with fixed set order
pdf("UpSet_merged_conditions_ordered.pdf", width = 12, height = 7)

upset(
  presence_df,
  sets = sets_to_plot,
  keep.order = TRUE,            # Prevents UpSetR from sorting rows by total set size
  nintersects = 25,
  order.by = "freq",
  decreasing = TRUE,
  show.numbers = FALSE,
  mb.ratio = c(0.6, 0.4),
  point.size = 2.8,
  line.size = 0.8,
  text.scale = c(1.3, 1.2, 1.2, 1.1, 1.2, 1.2),
  mainbar.y.label = "Peak Intersection Size",
  sets.x.label = "Total Peaks per Condition"
)

dev.off()

png(
  filename = "UpSet_merged_conditions_ordered.png",
  width = 12,
  height = 7,
  units = "in",
  res = 300
)

upset(
  presence_df,
  sets = sets_to_plot,
  keep.order = TRUE,            # Prevents UpSetR from sorting rows by total set size
  nintersects = 25,
  order.by = "freq",
  decreasing = TRUE,
  show.numbers = FALSE,
  mb.ratio = c(0.6, 0.4),
  point.size = 2.8,
  line.size = 0.8,
  text.scale = c(1.3, 1.2, 1.2, 1.1, 1.2, 1.2),
  mainbar.y.label = "Peak Intersection Size",
  sets.x.label = "Total Peaks per Condition"
)

# Close graphics device to write file to disk
dev.off()
```

#Do the same for 3911
```{r}
library(GenomicRanges)
library(rtracklayer)
library(UpSetR)

# Set working directory to project_3911 peaks
setwd("/data/jenuwein/erikson/2026/ulATAC/project_3911/hg38_AOS/peaks")

# 1. Read peak files
peak_files <- list.files(pattern = "\\.filtered_peaks\\.narrowPeak$", full.names = TRUE)
peak_list <- lapply(peak_files, function(f) import(f, format = "narrowPeak"))
names(peak_list) <- gsub("\\.filtered_peaks\\.narrowPeak$", "", basename(peak_files))

# 2. Merge replicates (Union of rep1, rep2, rep3, rep4, etc.)
groups <- gsub("_rep[0-9]+$", "", names(peak_list))
unique_groups <- unique(groups)

merged_peak_list <- lapply(unique_groups, function(grp) {
  reps <- peak_list[groups == grp]
  reduce(unlist(GRangesList(reps)))
})
names(merged_peak_list) <- unique_groups

# 3. Create master union and binary matrix
master_union <- reduce(unlist(GRangesList(merged_peak_list)))
presence_df <- as.data.frame(lapply(merged_peak_list, function(gr) {
  as.integer(overlapsAny(master_union, gr))
}))

# 4. Map original sample names to ordered short names
name_mapping <- c(
  "HepG2_ulATAC_LowCell_10"     = "ulATAC_10",
  "HepG2_ulATAC_LowCell_100"    = "ulATAC_100",
  "HepG2_ulATAC_LowCell_1000"   = "ulATAC_1000",
  "HepG2_ulATAC_LowCell_5000"   = "ulATAC_5000",
  "HepG2_ulATAC_HighCell_5000"  = "ulATAC_5000_High",
  "HepG2_ulATAC_HighCell_10000" = "ulATAC_10000",
  "HepG2_ulATAC_HighCell_25000" = "ulATAC_25000",
  "HepG2_ulATAC_HighCell_50000" = "ulATAC_50000"
)

# Apply renaming to dataframe columns
colnames(presence_df) <- ifelse(
  colnames(presence_df) %in% names(name_mapping),
  name_mapping[colnames(presence_df)],
  colnames(presence_df)
)

# 5. Define exact desired display order
target_order <- c(
  "ulATAC_10",
  "ulATAC_100",
  "ulATAC_1000",
  "ulATAC_5000",
  "ulATAC_5000_High",
  "ulATAC_10000",
  "ulATAC_25000",
  "ulATAC_50000"
)

# Filter order vector to only sets actually present in dataframe
sets_to_plot <- target_order[target_order %in% colnames(presence_df)]

# 6. Export PDF
pdf("ulATAC_UpSet_merged_conditions_ordered.pdf", width = 12, height = 7)

upset(
  presence_df,
  sets = sets_to_plot,
  keep.order = TRUE,            # Prevents UpSetR from sorting rows by total set size
  nintersects = 25,
  order.by = "freq",
  decreasing = TRUE,
  show.numbers = FALSE,
  mb.ratio = c(0.6, 0.4),
  point.size = 2.8,
  line.size = 0.8,
  text.scale = c(1.3, 1.2, 1.2, 1.1, 1.2, 1.2),
  mainbar.y.label = "Peak Intersection Size",
  sets.x.label = "Total Peaks per Condition"
)

dev.off()

# 7. Export High-Res PNG (300 DPI)
png(
  filename = "UlATAC_UpSet_merged_conditions_ordered.png",
  width = 12,
  height = 7,
  units = "in",
  res = 300
)

upset(
  presence_df,
  sets = sets_to_plot,
  keep.order = TRUE,            # Prevents UpSetR from sorting rows by total set size
  nintersects = 25,
  order.by = "freq",
  decreasing = TRUE,
  show.numbers = FALSE,
  mb.ratio = c(0.6, 0.4),
  point.size = 2.8,
  line.size = 0.8,
  text.scale = c(1.3, 1.2, 1.2, 1.1, 1.2, 1.2),
  mainbar.y.label = "Peak Intersection Size",
  sets.x.label = "Total Peaks per Condition"
)

dev.off()
```
